issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to mark the end of the main loop with the label `loop_end`, but the solution repository uses the label `end_loop`. This naming mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about the expected label name and cause them to think their solution is incorrect even when semantics are identical.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the label name consistent. Either change the solution's label `end_loop` to `loop_end`, or update the problem statement to request `end_loop`. Preferably update the solution file to use `loop_end` so it matches the instruction given to students.
